name: Not the right person
subject: Passing this to the right person
body:
Hello {{first name}},

Thank you for writing about {{subject}}. I am not the right person for this, so I am forwarding it to the person who handles it.

I have asked them to reply to you at {{email}}. If you do not hear back, send a nudge and I will chase it.
description: Says this reached the wrong person and points it onward.
